criteria.text: A typed Rhythm tools service routes production-owned Email and Gallery through Rhythm Cloud and all paired-Mac tools through the authenticated mobile gateway without exposing either credential.
criteria.test_id: issue-1173-c1: tool transports stay origin and credential isolated

criteria.text: Brain supports list, search, detail, create, edit, and confirmed delete using secret-free read-only offline cache.
criteria.test_id: issue-1173-c2: Brain CRUD search and offline cache

criteria.text: Research supports create, progress/status, detail/report, retry, and delete with safe summaries.
Scheduled Jobs supports create, edit, enable/disable, confirmed run-now, run status, and confirmed delete.
criteria.test_id: issue-1173-c4: Scheduled Job lifecycle and confirmations

criteria.text: Webhooks supports create, copy URL, rotate/revoke, and confirmed delete while secrets are displayed exactly once and are never persisted.
criteria.test_id: issue-1173-c5: webhook secrets remain one-time and uncached

criteria.text: Profiles supports prompt, model, delegation, and permission-scope edits; preserves null-versus-empty scope semantics; and waits for server projection confirmation before refresh.
criteria.test_id: issue-1173-c6: Profile edits preserve scope and projection ordering

criteria.text: Cookbook supports recipe CRUD and confirmed run with useful execution feedback.
criteria.test_id: issue-1173-c7: Cookbook CRUD and confirmed execution

criteria.text: Review Queue exposes proposal details and approve/reject actions with high-risk approval confirmation, while Report Card renders run-quality summaries.
criteria.test_id: issue-1173-c8: Review Queue risk controls and Report Card

criteria.text: Email and Gallery remain usable through production Rhythm Cloud while the paired Mac is offline, use least-privilege summaries, and never cache full email bodies or OAuth data.
criteria.test_id: issue-1173-c9: cloud tools survive paired host outage without sensitive caching

criteria.text: Skills, Playbooks, MCP, and Providers/Models expose approved metadata and lifecycle operations, compatibility-feature gating, OAuth handoff, and destructive confirmations by reusing existing provider services.
criteria.test_id: issue-1173-c10: paired integrations lifecycle and feature gating

criteria.text: Every dedicated tool screen handles loading, empty, secret-free offline cache, forbidden, expired-auth, and retryable server error with accessible Dynamic Type and dark-mode-safe UI.
criteria.test_id: issue-1173-c11: every screen declares resilient accessible states

criteria.text: Contract, fake-server, E2E, lint, typecheck, accessibility, and independent security/quality reviews pass.
criteria.test_id: issue-1173-c12: all fourteen tools are navigable and reviewed
